errors.text_span: colored differently—primarily in various shades of blue, green, orange, and purple—to distinguish them visually
errors.evidence: The 26 outer categories are not colored differently to distinguish them from each other. Instead, their colors are used to group them under one of the four main principles. All categories under 'Beneficence' are blue, all under 'Justice' are orange/peach, etc.

errors.text_span: the outer ring appearing to be organized in a roughly clockwise, descending order of size relative to their associated principle
errors.evidence: The chart does not show that the groups of principles are organized in descending order of size (number of sub-categories). The number of sub-categories for each principle, in clockwise order, is 11 (Beneficence), 4 (Justice), 4 (Non-Maleficence), and 7 (Autonomy), which is not a descending sequence.
